Pass vector express boundary moves time. turns number spiral revolutions across series. per_turn radial growth factor per revolution. amp radial amplitude value ribbon (fraction local radius). pal fill gradient value ribbon. show_years logical; draw year markers along spiral (default TRUE). n_labels approximate number markers. min_label_frac drop markers whose radius fraction outermost radius, crammed inner whorls stay unlabelled (default 0.4). label_fmt function applied marker values drawing; default rounds one decimal. strictly yearly data pass round. title optional plot title.
